hints.backup-password: This password encrypts your backup file. Save it somewhere safe — without it, the backup cannot be restored. It is shown only once on this screen; if you navigate away it cannot be recovered.

password-protect.title: Encrypt with password
password-protect.description: Encrypt the backup with a one-time password (AES-256). Recommended.

warnings.security-data-title: This backup will contain sensitive data
warnings.security-data-body: Password hashes, API keys, and security stamps for all users will be included. Anyone with access to the backup file can use it to take over user accounts. Store the file in a secure location and limit who can download it.
warnings.no-encryption-body: Anyone who can read the file can recover user passwords and API keys. Only proceed if the file will never leave a secured environment.

labels.select-file: Select .zip file to restore. The file must be produced by Virto Commerce data backup
labels.drag-note: Drag and drop .zip file to restore. The file must be produced by Virto Commerce data backup
labels.drag-or-browse: Drag and drop a .zip file here, or click to browse
labels.drag-note-detail: The file must be produced by Virto Commerce data backup
labels.upload-processing: Upload complete — validating on the server…
labels.existing-backups: Or restore from a backup already in storage
labels.no-existing-backups: No backups found in storage. Upload one above, or copy a backup into the storage 'backups' folder, then refresh.
labels.author: Author

placeholders.password: Enter the password shown when this backup was created

hints.password: Enter the password shown when this backup was created.
hints.existing-backups: Reuse a file that is already in blob storage instead of uploading it.

errors.upload-too-large: This file is too large to upload — it exceeds the server's upload size limit (typically 100 MB for this environment). Use a smaller backup (for example, exclude binary data), or ask your administrator to raise the limit.
errors.upload-no-response: The file was sent but the server never responded. This usually means the file exceeds the upload size limit (often 100 MB). Try a smaller backup, or ask your administrator to raise the limit.
errors.upload-stalled: The upload stalled — no data was transferred for a while. Check your network connection and try again.
errors.upload-gateway-timeout: The server did not respond in time while receiving the file. Large uploads can exceed the gateway timeout — try again or use a smaller backup.
errors.upload-gateway-unavailable: The upload service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.upload-unauthorized: You are not authorized to upload this file, or your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.upload-network: The upload failed because of a network error or an interrupted connection. Please try again.

warnings.security-data-title: This restore will overwrite sensitive data
warnings.security-data-body: User passwords, API keys, and security stamps from the backup will replace the current values for every user in the file.
warnings.security-data-admin-preserved: Your own admin account ({{username}}) will not be modified — your password and active session are preserved.
